Uploaded recordings no longer pick up another recording's transcript, and live agenda checks use far less AI quota on long meetings.

**Uploads get their own transcript** (#739)

- Two different recordings with the same file name and size (REC001.WAV, audio.m4a, same length) used to share a cached transcript, so the second upload came back with the first one's text. Parley now tells recordings apart by their content. Re-uploading the exact same file is still instant.
- A recording that already got the wrong transcript can be fixed with 重新轉錄 (Re-transcribe).

**Lighter live agenda checks** (#735)

- During a meeting with a drafted agenda, each check now reads only what was said since the last one, instead of the whole transcript so far, and skips entirely when nothing new was said.

**Smoother setup** (#725)

- Onboarding steps ease in instead of snapping, and the sign-in button keeps its size while signing in.
